title: Human vs AI Challenge
description: Answer each question, then see what the AI guide picks. Who knows the campus better?

questions.question: Which location has a running track and football field?
questions.explanation: The playground has a football field and running track.

questions.question: Where do students learn coding and AI basics?
questions.explanation: Coding and AI projects happen in the computer laboratory.

questions.question: Which place has a stage with lighting and a sound system?
questions.explanation: The auditorium stage hosts performances and assemblies.

questions.question: Where can you find a story corner for younger students?
questions.explanation: The library has a story corner for younger readers.

questions.question: What does the eco club look after?
questions.explanation: The eco club cares for the school garden.
